Frequently Asked Questions

Expert guidance on Residential Fit-Out in Abu Dhabi.

Answers to common project and execution questions from our UAE site engineering team.

What residential properties does NASAQ work on in Abu Dhabi?

NASAQ works on private villas, penthouses, apartments, and townhouses across prime Abu Dhabi areas including Saadiyat, Yas, Al Reem, and Khalifa City.

Can you execute apartment fit-outs in high-rise residential towers?

Yes. Our team regularly coordinates tower fit-out works in Al Reem Island and Al Raha Beach, adhering strictly to property management work permits and service elevator bookings.

How do you manage noise restrictions in apartment developments?

We schedule noisy drilling and demolition exclusively within developer-approved hours (typically 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM) to ensure community peace.
